description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 4720015740148 HOSE ASSEMBLY,NONME: Line 0001 Qty 127 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0113 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 11. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 19. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 076M6 TV060013; 0FW39 TV060013; 62534 RD-2-4988-0. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
